name: UI：环节参数详情-入参取值配置{{stage.xxx}}占位符渲染验证
description: 验证入参取值配置区域的参数值以Liquid模板语法{{stage.uuid.field}}格式渲染，且各字段占位符不重复

steps.expression: (() => { const spans = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('span')); const el = spans.find(s => (s.textContent || '').trim() === '入参'); if (!el) return { found: false }; const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return { found: true, x: rect.x + rect.width/2, y: rect.y + rect.height/2 }; })()

(() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const allText = drawer.textContent || ''; const hasConfig = allText.includes('入参取值配置'); // Find all input/textarea elements inside the drawer const inputs = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const placeholders = inputs.map(inp => ({ value: inp.value || '', placeholder: inp.placeholder || '', type: inp.type, disabled: inp.disabled, readOnly: inp.readOnly })).filter(p => p.value.includes('{{') || p.value.includes('stage') || p.placeholder.includes('stage')); // Also check rendered text with {{}} pattern const allElements = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('*')); const templateTexts = allElements.map(el => (el.textContent || '').trim()).filter(t => t.match(/\{\{.*stage.*\}\}/) && t.length < 200).slice(0, 20); return { open: true, hasConfig, inputCount: inputs.length, placeholderInputs: placeholders.length, placeholderSamples: placeholders.slice(0, 6), templateTexts: templateTexts.slice(0, 10) }; })()
steps.description: 分析入参取值配置中的占位符
入参取值配置板块存在

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); if (!drawer) return {}; // Find the config section specifically const configSection = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('*')).find(el => (el.textContent || '').startsWith('入参取值配置')); // Get all form fields with their labels and values const fields = []; const labels = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('[class*=label], [class*=Label], label, [class*=formItem], [class*=FormItem]')); for (const label of labels) { const text = (label.textContent || '').trim(); if (['seller_id', 'seed_image_url', 'tao_cate', 'item_id', 'back_img_url', 'skc_img_url'].some(p => text.includes(p))) { const input = label.querySelector('input, textarea') || label.nextElementSibling?.querySelector('input, textarea'); if (input) { fields.push({ label: text.substring(0, 30), value: (input.value || '').substring(0, 100), isTemplate: (input.value || '').includes('{{'), hasStage: (input.value || '').includes('stage') }); } } } return { fieldCount: fields.length, fields, templateFieldCount: fields.filter(f => f.isTemplate).length }; })()
steps.description: 提取各参数字段的值和模板格式
至少识别到1个表单字段
至少1个字段使用{{}}模板语法

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); if (!drawer) return {}; // Look for unique stage UUIDs in the values const allInputs = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const uuids = new Set(); const stageRefs = []; for (const inp of allInputs) { const val = inp.value || ''; const matches = val.matchAll(/stage\.([0-9a-f-]+)/g); for (const m of matches) { uuids.add(m[1]); stageRefs.push({ field: val.substring(0, 40), uuid: m[1] }); } } // Check that different fields reference different stage UUIDs (or same for chained) const uniqueCount = uuids.size; return { uniqueUuidCount: uniqueCount, uuids: Array.from(uuids).slice(0, 5), refs: stageRefs.slice(0, 10), allRefsHaveStage: stageRefs.length > 0 }; })()
steps.description: 验证占位符中的stage UUID引用

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer'); const btns = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('button')); const cancel = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('取')); if (!cancel) return { found: false }; const r = cancel.getBoundingClientRect(); return { found: true, x: r.x + r.width/2, y: r.y + r.height/2 }; })()
